text: Instead of Tetris (which requires app/phone), you can use the "Color-Path Connect" method. It hasn't been tested the way Tetris has, but it is built on the same idea: it makes your brain map 3D space, which competes with the visual "saving" of a traumatic memory. Skip counting and word games, though: in the lab, a verbal quiz game after a trauma film led to more flashbacks, not fewer (Holmes, et al, 2010).
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what
